description: Supabase puts useful app tools around PostgreSQL. This starter course uses a local Supabase project and a public sample book list. Learn tables, read permissions and clear client queries without adding a login to this website. Use the Supabase local CLI with its required container runtime, then run supabase init and supabase start in a practice project. Use the local URL and public key reported by its status command. SQL runs in the local database tools.
versionNote: Uses Supabase JavaScript client v2, local PostgreSQL and row-level security for a public read-only book list.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to explain which rule protects a positive page count
Learn to name the operations this policy does not allow
Learn to reverse the page order to find the longest books
